description: This file implements a GPX (GPS Exchange Format) parser class, GpxParser, which reads and extracts GPS fix data from GPX files or strings. It includes functions for parsing XML nodes, handling errors, and managing memory, and defines methods for parsing files and memory buffers containing GPX data.

classes.name: GpxParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing GPX files and strings to extract GPS fix data.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a GPX file specified by file path and fills the provided GpsFixArray with parsed data.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses a GPX data string of given length and fills the provided GpsFixArray with parsed data.
